verses.pali: “Sattahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānenapi.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when a friend has seven qualities you should associate with, accompany, and attend them, even if they drive you away.

verses.pali: Piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca vattā ca vacanakkhamo ca gambhīrañca kathaṁ kattā hoti, no ca aṭṭhāne niyojeti.
verses.english: They’re likable, agreeable, respected, and admired. They admonish you and they accept admonishment. They speak on deep matters. And they don’t urge you to do bad things.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānenapīti.
verses.english: When a friend has these seven qualities you should associate with, accompany, and attend them, even if they drive you away.
and doesn’t urge you to do bad.
these things are found is your friend.
If you want to have a friend,
then even if they chase you away,
you should keep company with that sort.”
